name: Annotated Business Board
description: A clean hand-drawn economics explainer: one unmistakable business or location in the center, surrounded by a small visual system of costs, people, tools, and outcomes. The final headline is composited by Story Studio so it stays perfectly legible.
tagline: Diagram-like business explainer with a safe headline band

recipe.conceptGuidance: Build an instantly readable visual economics board. Show one recognizable business, company, facility, or operating system as the large central hero; use a few surrounding representative objects to reveal how it earns, spends, and operates.
compositionRules: Reserve the full upper quarter as clean, quiet title space; do not place subjects, labels, signs, letters, numbers, or logos there.
Use exactly one large central hero subject in the lower two-thirds, with a clear silhouette at mobile size.
Place six to eight small supporting objects around the hero in a balanced diagram-like perimeter; communicate ideas through objects, not written callouts.
Keep the background warm off-white with clean dark ink outlines, restrained natural colors, and generous breathing room.
requiredElements: one central business, location, or operational hero
a small perimeter of representative cost, revenue, labor, supply, or customer objects
large uncluttered title-safe band at the top
avoid: letters, words, numbers, signs, labels, logos, watermarks, or pseudo-text
photorealistic advertising imagery or copied brand trade dress
recipe.visualStyleGuidance: Clean original 2D hand-drawn editorial illustration: fine black ink outlines, lightly painted color fills, warm white paper, simple crosshatching, crisp silhouettes, and restrained detail. It should feel like an explanatory visual board, never a literal copy of another channel's artwork.
